content: Ɨnyarʉbha kʉbhaatʉ bha risengerero rya Saridi

Neho ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo nchu Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Ʉmwandɨkɨrɨ maraika wa risengerero rya Saridi, ʉmʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ: “Inyɨ nɨrakangata zekoro muhungatɨ za Mungu na nɨna zenzota muhungatɨ. Ganʉ nego amangʼana gaanɨ! “Nɨmɨnyirɨ amahocha gaanyu. Mʉrarorekana nɨ‑bhahʉru, nawe mukuurɨ.
Motengeeze! Mʉnajɨ amasuuhu ganʉ gasaagirɨ, kʉ kʉbha garɨ haguhɨ kukwa. Amahocha gaanyu gakɨɨrɨ kuhikɨra chɨmbu Mungu waanɨ akwenda.
Muhiitɨ ganʉ mwijibhwɨ, na chɨmbu mwigwirɨ. Nangʉ mʉgagwatɨ, mutigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ. Mʉrɨɨtamɨ kotengeeza, nɨraaza nchu umwibhi na mʉtakomenya ribhaga rɨnʉ nikuhika kwa niimwɨ.

“Nawe kʉna abhahɨmba bhasuuhu gatɨ waanyu Saridi iyo, bhanʉ bhakɨɨrɨ kubhuruurya zengebho zaabhʉ ko kokora ʉbhʉbhɨ. Bharabha hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, bhariibhʉhibhwa zengebho zɨnzɨrʉ, kʉ kʉbha abhaatʉ bhayo bhareenderwa.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araahizɨ, nɨramwibhʉhya zengebho zɨnzɨrʉ ncha bhayo. Nɨtakuruusha iriina ryazɨ mʉkɨtabhʉ chʉ ʉbhʉhʉru,
nawe nɨramwisirirya mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Bhaabha Mungu na bhamaraika bhaazɨ.
“Wʉ ʉkʉtwɨ iitegeerere amangʼana ganʉ Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨkʉbhʉʉrɨra amasengerero.”
Ɨnyarʉbha kʉbhaatʉ bha risengerero rya Firadɨrifiya
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wurya akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Ʉmwandɨkɨrɨ maraika wa risengerero rya Firadɨrifiya, ʉmʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ: “Inyɨ mʉrɨndu nɨrɨ na we eheene, naatu niinyɨ ninu uruhunguru rwʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi.
Niriigarɨ ikisikʉ, atareeho ʉwʉndɨ wʉnʉ araatʉrɨ kwigʉra. Naatu niriigʉrɨ, atareeho ʉwʉndɨ wʉnʉ araatʉrɨ kwigara.
Ganʉ nego amangʼana gaanɨ!

“Nɨmɨnyirɨ amahocha gaanyu. Mwitegeerere! Inyɨ niigwirɨ ikisikʉ, atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kwigara. Nangabha nguru zaanyu, ni‑suuhu, nawe mugwatirɨ amiija gaanɨ, mʉtaanyangirɨ kʉbha abhahɨmba bhaanɨ mʉrɨ.

Mwitegeerere! Nɨrabhaha abhahɨmba bha Shɨtaani bhanʉ bhakwibhɨrɨkɨra Abhayaahudi nawe ɨtarɨ, naatu bhaana ɨkɨbhɨɨhi. Mmbe bhanʉ nɨrabhakora bhaazɨ bhabhahigamɨrɨ. Bhayo bhʉʉsi bharamenya nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ imwɨ.
“Rɨraaza ribhaga ryɨ ɨnyaakʉ kʉʉsɨ yʉʉsi, na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharagemwa. Nawe ribhaga riyo nɨrabhariibha kʉ kʉbha mukiigumirirya ɨnyaakʉ chɨmbu nabharagɨɨnʼyɨ.
Nɨraaza bhwangʉ! Mʉgagwatɨrɨrɨ bhwaheene amazʉmu ganʉ mʉnagʉ, korereke ʉmʉʉtʉ ataaza abharuushɨ ɨbhɨrʉngʉ bhyanyu.

“Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araahizɨ, nɨramokora abhɨ rirʉmbɨrʉ rya rihekaaru rya Mungu kwisaarʉ, wʉʉsi atakurwa muyo. Akʉmara nɨramwandɨka iriina rya Mungu ni iriina ryʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Mungu. Ʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ nɨ‑Yɨrusarɨɨmu iihya, rʉnʉ ruriituumɨ kurwa mwisaarʉ kwa Mungu. Naatu nɨramwandɨka iriina ryanɨ riihya.
“Wʉ ʉkʉtwɨ iitegeerere amangʼana ganʉ Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨkʉbhʉʉrɨra amasengerero.”
Ɨnyarʉbha kʉbhaatʉ bha risengerero rya Raʉdikiya

Ʉmʉʉtʉ wurya akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Ʉmwandɨkɨrɨ maraika wa risengerero rya Raʉdikiya, ʉmʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ: “Inyɨ niinyɨ nɨrabhirikirwa Garamɨ, wʉnʉ akomenyeekererya amaheene ga Mungu koheene. Inyɨ niinyɨ ʉbhʉtangɨ bhwi ibhityɨnyi bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ Mungu aatɨɨmirɨ. Ganʉ nego amangʼana gaanɨ!
“Inyɨ nɨmɨnyirɨ amahocha gaanyu. Nɨmɨnyirɨ mʉtarɨ bhamititu hamwɨ morero. Hakɨrɨku mʉbhɨ morero hamwɨ bhamititu!
Nawe kʉ kʉbha muhyukirɨ, mʉtarɨ morero hamwɨ bhamititu, nɨrabharʉka murwɨ mumunywa gwanɨ.

Mʉrabhuga, ‘Itwɨ, nɨ‑bhaniibhi. Twiniibhiryɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Tone ebhegero bhyʉsi, tʉtakusuuhirwa nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu!’ Mʉtɨɨzɨ imwɨ nɨ‑bhanyʉʉhɨrɨru, moreenderwa kororerwa ɨbhɨgʉngi, bhahabhɨ mʉrɨ, bhahʉku mʉrɨ ɨnʉ mʉrɨ tʉʉhʉ.

Kwɨbhu nɨrabhatongera mʉgʉrɨ ɨzahaabhu kurwa ɨwaanɨ, ɨzahaabhu yɨnʉ yʉjibhwɨ no omorero korereke mʉbhɨ bhaniibhi. Mʉgʉrɨ ne engebho ɨnzɨrʉ, mukundikiryɨ ɨtʉʉhʉ yanyu korereke mʉtarora zɨsʉni. Mʉgʉrɨ ʉmʉtɨ gʉ ʉkʉbhahaka mʉmɨɨsʉ korereke morore.
“Inyɨ nɨhaatongera na kuhiinya abhaatʉ bhanʉ nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ. Mmbe mʉbhɨ nu ubhwigumirirya na mutigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Mwitegeerere! Inyɨ nimiiriirɨ kukisikʉ nɨrabhɨrɨkɨra. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ariigwɨ riraka ryanɨ nu ukunyiigʉrɨra ikisikʉ, nɨrasikɨra munyumba yaazɨ na tʉrarya hamwɨmwɨ.
“Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araahizɨ, nɨramwisiririrya kwikara na niinyɨ kukitumbɨ chanɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi, chɨmbu inyɨ nahizirɨ, nikiikara na Bhaabha kukitumbɨ chazɨ chʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi.
“Wʉ ʉkʉtwɨ iitegeerere amangʼana ganʉ Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨkʉbhʉʉrɨra amasengerero.”

a Daudi. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
